title: Anki-Connect API v1 specification
description: Implemented API contract. Validate envelopes at the root, then use x-methods to validate the named method and its response. Runtime availability is reported by api.describe; GUI and sync verification remain incomplete.

EntityId.description: Positive signed int64 in decimal; additionally enforce <= 9223372036854775807.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp, emitted with Z; millisecond precision when available.

api.describe.summary: Discover methods, schemas, limits and runtime capabilities.

access.requestPermission.summary: Ask for access using the transport-supplied origin.
access.requestPermission.notes: Never accept origin or allowed from parameters. Authentication exemption matches legacy permission discovery.

profiles.getActive.summary: Return the active profile or null.

profiles.switch.summary: Switch profiles and finish when the destination collection is ready.

collection.get.summary: Inspect the active collection and its session.

collection.sync.notes: Full sync choices are waitingForUser; never launch a second sync. includeMedia is intersected with profile media-sync settings.

collection.refresh.summary: Refresh windows, optionally invalidating supported collection caches first.
collection.refresh.notes: Does not close/reopen the collection and does not repair invalid scheduling state.

collection.checkIntegrity.summary: Run Anki database checks and repairs with normal UI completion.

collection.undo.summary: Undo the current Anki undo entry.

notes.get.summary: Get a note, including an empty cardIds array for cardless notes.

notes.getMany.summary: Get notes in input order, preserving repeated IDs.

notes.search.summary: Search with Anki syntax; an empty query searches all notes.

notes.validate.summary: Validate note content and duplicate scope without acquiring media.
notes.validate.notes: Semantic content failures return valid=false and issues; bad references or parameter types are RPC errors.

notes.validateMany.summary: Validate each note independently without side effects.

notes.create.summary: Create a note and return its actual generated cards.

notes.createMany.summary: Create notes independently, or as one native atomic collection batch.
notes.createMany.notes: atomic=true validates the full set including within-batch duplicates, then uses Collection.add_notes. Any failure is a top-level error with indexed issues and no collection changes. Success keeps the same items result shape. Empty input is a no-op.

notes.update.summary: Apply fields and tags together in one native note update.

notes.delete.summary: Delete notes and their cards; missing IDs are item errors.

notes.planConversion.summary: Get native suggested field/template mappings and a schema token.

notes.convert.summary: Convert same-type notes through Anki note-type conversion.
notes.convert.notes: Mappings are complete target-name to source-name/null lists. Reject duplicate source mappings, mixed source note types and stale tokens. Removed source templates lose their cards/history as defined by Anki; cloze mappings use native supported rules, never raw mid assignment.

notes.findEmpty.summary: Find cleanup candidates by an explicit criterion.
notes.findEmpty.notes: No deletion. allFieldsEmpty uses native HTML-aware emptiness; allQuestionsEmpty uses native empty-card generation. Return all matching IDs through normal cursor pagination.

tags.replace.summary: Replace a tag on explicit notes or all notes.
tags.replace.notes: Exactly one selector: noteIds or allNotes=true. Never interpret an omitted selector as all notes.

cards.get.summary: Read stored card state without rendering or predicting answers.

cards.search.summary: Search cards using Anki search syntax.

cards.render.summary: Render a stored card with Anki rendering.

cards.move.summary: Move cards with Collection.set_deck and target-preset invariants.
cards.move.notes: Target must already exist and be normal. Moving out of a filtered deck restores native state first through the native move operation.

cards.setSuspended.notes: changed=false means already in requested state. Process repeated mutation IDs once and repeat their result.

cards.setFlags.summary: Set the user flag through Anki native flag persistence.
cards.setFlags.notes: Zero clears the user flag; preserve other backend flag bits.

scheduling.getQueue.summary: Read cards in native scheduler order with remaining counts.
scheduling.getQueue.notes: Uses Anki's currently selected deck and respects native limits, mixing and scheduler order. Reading the queue is idempotent; subsequent scheduling changes can change the snapshot.

scheduling.predict.summary: Predict native answers and issue a session-scoped state token.
scheduling.predict.notes: Does not represent custom states held by the GUI reviewer. Tokens are invalidated by relevant writes, undo, profile change and scheduler-day rollover.

scheduling.getDue.summary: Inspect queue-aware due eligibility without requiring history.
scheduling.getDue.notes: dueNow excludes learn-ahead and suspended/buried queues. New cards are available but have no timed due obligation. available ignores daily deck limits; includeLearnAhead expands learning availability only.

scheduling.answer.summary: Answer using native states matching the supplied prediction token.
scheduling.answer.notes: Reject suspended/buried and filtered-preview cards. For the active GUI card use reviewer.answer. Native elapsed-time capping applies. No client-supplied historical answer timestamp.

scheduling.answerMany.summary: Answer cards independently in input order.

scheduling.reset.summary: Reset cards as new using the native scheduler.

scheduling.setDueDate.summary: Set due dates using Anki native days/range syntax.

decks.list.summary: List decks in case-sensitive name order.

decks.get.summary: Resolve a deck without creating it or falling back to Default.

decks.create.summary: Create a normal deck, returning the existing deck for an exact existing name.

decks.update.summary: Rename a deck using native hierarchy handling.

decks.delete.summary: Delete decks and their cards with explicit acknowledgement.
decks.delete.notes: Includes native child-deck deletion and removal of resulting cardless notes; deleting Default follows native behavior.

decks.getCounts.summary: Get native due-tree counts and total cards.

deckPresets.create.summary: Create a preset by cloning a specified preset or native defaults.

deckPresets.update.summary: Update a preset and all dependent cards through the coordinated backend request.
deckPresets.update.notes: Require name or settings. Preserve current target deck, collection settings, overrides and custom scheduler in the update request. rescheduleFsrs explicitly controls optional full rescheduling; mandatory native memory/step updates still run.

deckPresets.assign.summary: Assign a preset and execute native dependent-card updates.

deckPresets.delete.summary: Delete a preset, explicitly reassigning dependent decks first.
deckPresets.delete.notes: replacement is required when in use. Reject Default preset deletion. No changes occur on failed preflight; do not promise atomicity across multiple native backend operations.

noteTypes.list.summary: List note types in name order.

noteTypes.create.summary: Create a normal or cloze note type.

noteTypes.editStructure.summary: Apply ordered structural edits and persist once using native note-type updates.
noteTypes.editStructure.notes: Carry original field/template ordinals to preserve card identity. Added entries have no original ordinal. Validate all edits on a copy before saving; reject last field/template removal and invalid cloze structures.

noteTypes.getTemplateUsage.notes: Python adapter mirrors native token rules because the parsed tree is not exposed to Python. Includes conditional fields and filtered replacements, ignores HTML comments and special fields, supports legacy alternate delimiters, and returns real fields once in first-reference order.

noteTypes.replaceText.summary: Replace literal text in explicit note types or all note types.
noteTypes.replaceText.notes: Exactly one selector: noteTypes or allNoteTypes=true. Count changed types, not occurrences.

noteTypes.deleteUnused.summary: Delete only explicitly selected note types whose use count is zero.

media.store.summary: Acquire and store media using Anki filename normalization.
media.store.notes: Reject traversal and path separators in filename. Validate strict base64 and source types before acquisition. Skip comparison is against incoming bytes and never deletes an existing file. Replacement is explicit and not collection-undoable.

media.get.notes: A basename is required; no filesystem traversal or arbitrary paths.

media.list.summary: List normalized media basenames matching a basename glob.

media.delete.summary: Move media to Anki trash without deleting notes.

media.getDirectory.summary: Return the local active collection media directory.

reviews.list.summary: Read review history ordered by ascending review ID.
reviews.list.notes: cardIds and deck are mutually exclusive. No selector means all history. afterId is exclusive. Current/home membership is explicit for filtered cards.

reviews.getLatestId.summary: Return the latest matching history ID or null.

statistics.getToday.summary: Count actual reviews in Anki current scheduler day, excluding manual/rescheduled entries.

statistics.getReviewDays.summary: Return all nonempty historical review days in descending date order using native graph day conventions.

statistics.getSummary.summary: Get structured collection statistics or an explicit deck including children.

statistics.getHtml.summary: Return the supported legacy HTML report, labelled as such.

packages.import.summary: Import an Anki package with normal collection completion.

browser.open.summary: Open the browser and finish after the requested search/sort completes.
browser.open.notes: Omitted query preserves existing browser search. Explicit direction is applied regardless of previous/default column order.

browser.getSelection.summary: Read browser selection; closed browser returns open=false and empty arrays.

browser.select.summary: Replace selection in an already open browser.
browser.select.notes: Exactly one selector. Note IDs select their cards in card mode; card IDs select their notes in note mode. This method does not open a closed browser.

editors.openNote.summary: Open the custom note editor and finish once it is ready.

editors.openAdd.summary: Open or activate the configured Add editor and optionally populate a draft.
editors.openAdd.notes: Use the active legacy/Svelte variant. Do not run duplicate/empty-field eligibility checks on an unfinished draft. Return noteId=null until persisted; do not claim ID 0 identifies a future note.

editors.updateDraft.summary: Update an Add draft through coordinated dialog setters.
editors.updateDraft.notes: Set note type before explicit deck. replace changes only supplied fields/tags. append concatenates supplied field strings and unions tags; deck/type still replace. Reject invalid fields before altering the draft.

reviewer.get.summary: Read active reviewer state and retained custom scheduling predictions.
reviewer.get.notes: Inactive reviewer returns null card/rendered/token, side=none and empty answers.

reviewer.startTimer.summary: Restart the active reviewer card timer.

reviewer.showQuestion.summary: Show the question for the active reviewer card.

reviewer.showAnswer.summary: Show the answer for the active reviewer card.

reviewer.answer.summary: Answer the active card using reviewer-retained states and await actual completion.
reviewer.answer.notes: Requires answer side and an offered rating. Do not resolve success until backend completion and UI notifications; reviewer hook veto returns vetoed.

reviewer.playAudio.summary: Replay audio for the current side.

application.navigate.summary: Navigate the main window to a requested view.
application.navigate.notes: deck is required for deckOverview/review and prohibited for deckBrowser.

application.importFile.summary: Run the interactive import workflow, including file choice when omitted.

application.exit.summary: Acknowledge a close request, then initiate normal application close after sending the response.
application.exit.notes: Accepted means the request was scheduled, not that Anki has exited. Native close/save/sync dialogs may cancel it. Retain timer/callback ownership; process exit prevents polling a final operation result.

advanced.cards.update.summary: Edit validated expert scheduling metadata through native card persistence.
advanced.cards.update.notes: No id/noteId/deckId/template/queue/type/due/mod/usn writes. Moves, due changes and transitions use domain commands. Reject inconsistent coupled-state edits instead of inferring omitted state. Capability detection may restrict writable properties.

advanced.reviews.import.summary: Import historical revlog records, not live answers.
advanced.reviews.import.notes: Validate all records; reject duplicate IDs both internally and against collection. Derive answeredAt from ID, set usn=-1 locally. Bound SQL in one database transaction; no schema interpolation. Do not change card scheduling/counters or claim a live answer. FSRS memory remains current stored state; later recomputation may consume imported history. Expose only when transactional import and post-write notifications are verified.

api.execute.summary: Execute commands sequentially with completion barriers and independent results.
api.execute.notes: Continue after errors. No nested api.execute, application.exit or profiles.switch commands. Pin the active collection session for collection-scoped commands; a session change fails remaining such commands. Validate each command with its named method schema. Never an atomic transaction.

operations.get.summary: Poll operation status and its eventual typed result/error.

operations.cancel.summary: Request supported cancellation without claiming rollback.
operations.cancel.notes: Already terminal returns requested=false. Queued operations can cancel; running operations use native cancellation only. A cancellation request may lose a race with success.
